headline: From concept
to completion
hero.intro: Sheffield’s AV hire and event production team. Lighting, sound, staging and technical support for corporate events, festivals, live music, sport and award ceremonies.

howWeWork.heading: Every event comes full circle
howWeWork.intro: We work closely with you at every stage, tailoring the production to bring your vision to life.

steps.title: Concept
steps.body: We start by listening: your audience, your venue, your budget and the moment you want people to remember.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: Site visits, technical specs, power and timings, all mapped out together so there are no surprises on the day.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Our crew delivers and installs the staging, sound, lighting and video, then tests everything until it’s show-ready.

steps.title: Show
steps.body: Experienced technicians run your event live and stay until the last case is loaded out. That’s full circle.

testimonials.quote: An amazing crew with a wide variety of knowledge and very helpful. Definitely worth giving these lads a try regardless of the type of event you have planned, they can always bring something to it.
testimonials.name: Cllr Ian Jones

testimonials.quote: Full Circle Events were extremely responsive, friendly and professional. A great team – would definitely recommend!
testimonials.name: Amanda Hobson

testimonials.quote: Amazing service, very professional & full of knowledge.
testimonials.name: The Hive, Skegness

services.title: Award Ceremonies
services.summary: Seamless award ceremonies with AV hire, staging, lighting, sound and video, backed by over 20 years of experience.
services.imageAlt: Business awards stage with LED screens and starcloth

services.title: Conference and Seminars
services.summary: Corporate conferences, seminars and large-scale industry events, delivered with flawless event production.
services.imageAlt: Conference hall with stage, screen and lighting rig

services.title: Exhibition and Product Launches
services.summary: Everything you need to make your stand or launch stand out, whether you’re showcasing tech, fashion or innovation.
services.imageAlt: Exhibition stand lit for a product showcase

services.title: Celebrity Meet and Greets
services.summary: Meet and greets for big names in sport and entertainment, including Tyson Fury, Floyd Mayweather, Frank Bruno and Ricky Hatton.

services.title: Live Music
services.summary: From intimate acoustic sets and solo artists to high-energy 20-piece bands and dance concerts, with tailored sound, lighting and video.
services.imageAlt: Band performing in a marquee under moving lights

services.title: Festivals
services.summary: From intimate 200-capacity venues to large-scale concerts for up to 10,000 people, with production tailored to your festival.
services.imageAlt: Performer on a festival stage in front of a large crowd

services.title: Sporting Events
services.summary: From amateur and professional boxing to dance competitions and marathons, every moment captured and enhanced.
services.imageAlt: Full Circle technician at the control desk beside a boxing ring

services.title: Christmas
services.summary: Corporate parties, town and city centre events and venue celebrations, with custom LED lighting displays and light shows.
services.imageAlt: Christmas party set with LED letters and a light-up dance floor

services.title: Bonfire
services.summary: Community bonfire nights, public fireworks displays and large-scale celebrations, with full-scale event production.
services.imageAlt: Fireworks over a crowd at a bonfire event

services.title: Remembrance
services.summary: Proud to have supported Armistice Day celebrations, VE Day commemorations and Remembrance Sunday services across South Yorkshire.
services.imageAlt: Poppy projection on a church tower

services.title: Charity
services.summary: Fundraising galas, charity auctions and memory walks, with full AV production that helps drive impact for your cause.
services.imageAlt: Gala dinner hall lit in purple

services.title: Architectural Illuminations
services.summary: Dynamic outdoor lighting for grand openings, commemorations and special events, from iconic buildings to venue façades.

services.title: Power Distribution
services.summary: Safe, seamless temporary power for conferences, exhibitions, festivals and galas, supplied and installed by our team.
services.imageAlt: Temporary power cabling and distribution ready for install

disciplines.title: Audio
disciplines.summary: Crystal-clear sound for every scale, from small PA setups to festival systems, with engineers on the desk.

disciplines.title: Visual
disciplines.summary: Lighting, video and projection that set the mood and carry the message, inside the venue and out.

disciplines.title: Infrastructure
disciplines.summary: The backbone of the show, built safely and on schedule, from stages and custom sets to temporary power.
